import subprocess

# Final test run
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-x", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", 
     "tests/test_cache.py", "tests/test_cached.py", "tests/test_cachedmethod.py",
     "tests/test_fifo.py", "tests/test_func.py", "tests/test_keys.py",
     "tests/test_lfu.py", "tests/test_lru.py", "tests/test_mru.py",
     "tests/test_rr.py", "tests/test_tlru.py", "tests/test_ttl.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print("Tests:", result.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1])

# Verify commits
result = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "--oneline", "base..HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\nCommits:")
print(result.stdout)

# Verify public names
result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", "import cachetools; print('MRUCache in __all__:', 'MRUCache' in cachetools.__all__); print('cached in dir:', 'cached' in dir(cachetools)); print('cachedmethod in dir:', 'cachedmethod' in dir(cachetools))"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("\ncachetools checks:")
print(result.stdout)

result = subprocess.run(["python", "-c", "import cachetools.func; print('lru_cache in __all__:', 'lru_cache' in cachetools.func.__all__); print('mru_cache in __all__:', 'mru_cache' in cachetools.func.__all__)"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("cachetools.func checks:")
print(result.stdout)
